title: Lab: The Plan/Apply Loop
intro_md: Drive a Terraform configuration through its full lifecycle: init, validate, plan, apply, inspect state, and destroy.

steps.instruction_md: Initialize the working directory (downloads providers, sets up the backend).
steps.mock_output:
Initializing provider plugins...
- Installing hashicorp/aws v5.54.0...
Terraform has been successfully initialized!
steps.hint: Always the first command in a fresh Terraform directory.

steps.instruction_md: Check the configuration for syntax and internal consistency errors.
steps.hint: Not plan — the lighter-weight static check.

steps.instruction_md: Produce an execution plan and save it to a file named `tfplan`.
steps.mock_output:
Plan: 3 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
Saved the plan to: tfplan

Apply complete! Resources: 3 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.
Outputs:
public_ip = "52.31.4.18"
steps.hint: Pass the plan file as the argument — no -auto-approve needed, the plan IS the approval.

steps.instruction_md: List all resources currently tracked in state.
steps.hint: The state subcommand has a listing verb.

steps.instruction_md: Show the value of the output named `public_ip`.
Tear everything down without an interactive prompt.
steps.hint: destroy plus the flag that skips the yes/no prompt.
